label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Dismissing the cookie banner sent keyboard focus back to the top of the page, so I had to start over from the beginning

element.name: Do not sell or share my personal information

findings.problem: The cookie banner has no plainly labelled Decline button; the only way to refuse was a privacy-law wording button after the OK button, which is easy to mistake or miss

element.name: Do not sell or share my personal information

findings.problem: Before reaching the first product I had to tab through the slideshow controls, four page dots, and category tabs; then six size links for the first product before its Add to cart. About 25 key presses to add one item
Add to cart buttons are just named Add to cart with no product name, so I could not tell which product I was adding
After Add to cart nothing was announced and focus stayed on the button; a cart drawer opened elsewhere and I only found it by tabbing on, landing in the middle of it at Recently viewed

The Check out button in the cart drawer was about 18 key presses away, after quantity buttons, Remove, and the You may also like list with several Add buttons, with risk of changing the cart by accident
